about: Syngene (established in 1993) as a Biocon subsidiary is India's first Contract Research Organization (CRO) which expanded later to be an integrated service provider offering end-to-end drug discovery, development, and manufacturing services on a single platform (CRAMS). Total research & manufacturing infrastructure for the company is spread across 1.9 million square feet across locations. [1]
